description:
Full record for one incident or maintenance: current status,
    impact, start / resolve times and duration, scheduled window (for
    maintenance), affected components, the vendor's link, the Pingoru
    page (pingoru_url) and every status update with its timestamp. Use
    to summarise 'what happened during the May 3 outage'. Covers the
    last 30 days plus anything still open. Slug accepts shorthand /
    typos via fuzzy fallback.
name: incident_detail
